shots.text: When the Mountain Titan fell, the trees on its shoulders stopped burning.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Titan crashing down; grey lichen falling from its eyes; amber geode eyes opening. Orrok.

shots.speaker: orrok
shots.art_note: Orrok, enormous, looking at the towers. It is the first thing he has said in a thousand years.

shots.text: The Stoneborn sealed the Deep Halls of Grundhallow with their ancestors inside. Gorrim put a new ring in his beard, and did not speak of it.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The great stone doors of Grundhallow closing. Gorrim braiding an iron ring into his beard.
